decisions.reason: The plug-in line extends the established offer, still has its own page and costs little to maintain, so the option stays open at low cost.
The delegation service overlaps with Product E and could later be merged into it, but there is no evidence yet that its value will not be realized and keeping it costs little.
The open GIS framework underpins the component strategy and the firm's standards and research work, giving it high strategic option value at low marginal cost.
The identity service was actively announced and fits the firm's integration focus, so its prospects remain positive and further commitment is justified.
The consulting workshop is newly launched, has its own page and needs little more than existing staff time, so keeping it is cheap while demand shows itself.
